The '''Glacial Remnants''' was the name given to the remains of a glacier located in the northeastern corner of the [[Glacial Fissure]] region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], adjacent to the [[Glacial Paths]] and the [[Upper Pass]] from the [[Highmount Ridge]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Outpost Senth]] was built beneath the Remnants.

==Behind the scenes==
The Glacial Remnants is a subregion of the Glacial Fissure sector of Hoth in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The [[2012]] Digital Expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' made the Remnants into a Level 55 region where the Seeker Droid could be used.
